Title: How to find events
Summary: Discover events near you or online
Body: Start on the homepage and browse featured events, categories, and upcoming dates. You can search by keyword, filter by location or date, and explore different event types. When something stands out, open the event to see full details before booking.

Title: How to buy tickets
Summary: Buy tickets in a few simple steps
Body: Open the event page, choose your ticket type, select quantity, enter your details, and complete checkout. After booking, you will receive confirmation and ticket details by email.

Title: Refunds explained
Body: Each event sets its own refund policy. Check the event page for conditions and cut-off times. If you need help, contact the organiser first or reach out to MEL support.

Title: Accessibility at events
Body: Event pages may include accessibility details such as wheelchair access or hearing support. If unsure, contact the organiser before booking.

Title: Creating an account
Body: Click sign up, enter your details, and confirm your email. An account lets you manage bookings and track events.

Title: Resetting your password
Body: Use the forgot password option, enter your email, and follow the reset link sent to your inbox.

Title: What happens after booking
Body: After booking you receive confirmation and ticket details. Check event time and location before attending.

Title: Contacting support
Body: Check the event page first. Contact the organiser for event issues or MEL support for platform help.

Title: How to save events
Body: Use your account to save events you are interested in so you can find them easily later.

Title: Using filters to find events
Body: Use filters like date, location, and category to narrow down your search and find the right event.

Title: Adding events to your calendar
Body: After booking, add the event to your calendar to avoid missing it.

Title: Checking event details before booking
Body: Always check time, location, and refund policy before booking.

Title: Understanding ticket types
Body: Events may offer general, early bird, or VIP tickets. Choose the option that suits you.

Title: Booking multiple tickets
Body: Select the number of tickets during checkout. Make sure details are correct for all attendees.

Title: What to bring to an event
Body: Bring your ticket, check entry requirements, and arrive on time.

Title: Getting started as an organiser
Body: Click create event and follow the steps to set up your first event.

Title: How to create an event
Body: Enter name, time, location, and description, then publish.

Title: Setting up tickets
Body: Add free or paid tickets with pricing and limits.

Title: Managing attendees
Body: View and export attendee lists from your dashboard.

Title: Payouts and fees
Body: Payments are processed securely and paid out to your account.

Title: Editing your event
Body: Update your event information anytime before it starts.

Title: Event visibility and promotion
Body: Use clear titles and share your event to increase visibility.

Title: Handling refunds as an organiser
Body: Follow your event policy when handling refund requests.

Title: Choosing event categories
Body: Choose categories that match your event to improve discovery.

Title: Writing a strong event description
Body: Write clear and engaging descriptions to attract attendees.

Title: Setting event capacity
Body: Set limits to control attendance and avoid overbooking.

Title: Using images for your event
Body: Upload clear images to make your event more appealing.

Title: Tracking event performance
Body: Use dashboard insights to track bookings and engagement.

Title: Updating ticket availability
Body: Update quantities or pricing if needed before the event.

Title: Communicating with attendees
Body: Send updates or important information to attendees before the event.

Title: Refund decision flow
Body: Check policy, confirm details, approve or decline, escalate if needed.

Title: Vendor dispute handling
Body: Review complaint, check terms, contact vendor, document outcome.

Title: Event moderation checklist
Body: Ensure content is accurate, appropriate, and complete.

Title: Escalation handling guide
Body: Tag, prioritise, and notify relevant teams.

Title: Handling support requests
Body: Review request, provide solution, escalate if required.

Title: Reviewing refund edge cases
Body: Assess unusual refund scenarios carefully and escalate if needed.

Title: Content quality review
Body: Ensure clarity, accuracy, and compliance.

Title: Handling repeated complaints
Body: Identify patterns and escalate appropriately.

Title: Vendor onboarding support
Body: Guide new organisers through setup steps.

Title: Ticket issue resolution
Body: Check booking details and assist users with ticket problems.
